svg.title: Tokyo, drawn in ink — river with two boats
svg.desc: A Japanese-style vector panorama of Tokyo landmarks, a pale full moon and closed golden clouds. Two sculpted pines frame a stone bridge: the taller left pine curves away from Tokyo Station's central entrance, while the shorter right pine reaches left without hiding the temple gate's lantern. Their roots remain fixed on the riverbanks. Two traditional lantern-lit yakatabune boats balance the foreground.
